mission_01: Excellent work! You have mastered fundamental vector operations. You can now create vectors, compute their magnitudes, normalize them, and calculate both dot and cross products. The dot product of [3, 4, 5] and [1, -2, 3] equals 10, and the cross product gives [-2, 4, -10]. These operations form the foundation for everything from 3D graphics to neural network computations. Keep building on this knowledge!
